event: During release-path schema inspection, source code for the contrast-probe generator and lexical-reset generator was displayed. This exposed contrast wording and lexical-reset wording to the development agent.
training_status: All currently queued training datasets and the optional policy27 curriculum were frozen before this source inspection. No examples were added or changed using the exposed probe wording.
interpretation: These remain unscored model holdouts for the frozen candidates, but should not be described as analyst-blind. No independent annotation claim is made.
restriction: Do not author further training examples from exposed reserved wording or tune model choices using reserved results. Any subsequent adaptive round needs a separate fresh qualification set.
